name: The Essence of Eranikus
summary: At the Oathstone, Itharius reaches you through the stone and asks you to help redeem Eranikus's corrupted soul. The first sacrifice is the gem that chains the free part of Eranikus's mind. Itharius waits in the Swamp of Sorrows.

sections.title: A Voice Through the Stone
sections.body: Through the Oathstone, Itharius asks you to aid Ysera's Dragonflight in redeeming Eranikus's corrupted soul. He warns that many sacrifices will be asked of you both. First, give him the gem that chains the part of Eranikus's mind still free. Take the Oathstone and the Chained Essence of Eranikus to Itharius in the Swamp of Sorrows. There, you choose whether to aid the dragonflight.

sections.title: A Choice Made
sections.body: At another crossroads, Itharius asks you to choose. Then he says your choices so far have been right. What you do now will decide whether they remain so.

faq.answer: Through the Oathstone, Itharius speaks into your mind on behalf of Ysera's Dragonflight. He waits in the Swamp of Sorrows, seeking to redeem Eranikus's corrupted soul.

faq.q: What is the Chained Essence of Eranikus?
faq.answer: The Chained Essence of Eranikus is the gem that chains the part of Eranikus's mind still free. Itharius asks you to give it up as the first sacrifice.
It follows the first step of The Essence of Eranikus, which bears the same name.

faq.q: Where do you take the Oathstone and the essence?
faq.answer: Take the Oathstone and the essence to Itharius in the Swamp of Sorrows. There, you choose whether to aid the dragonflight.
